message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 292, "amount_cents": 2929}, {"order_id": 294, "amount_cents": 10248}, {"order_id": 295, "amount_cents": 5339}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 292, "amount_cents": 2929}, {"order_id": 294, "amount_cents": 10248}, {"order_id": 295, "amount_cents": 9055}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 295: the signed batch requested 9055 cents, but only 5339 cents is recorded in the ledger (list_refunds) and reported by W2 as applied. Orders 292 and 294 match. Alpha's refund work appears incomplete, so payouts are paused until the 295 refund is reconciled.

reply.thought: The handoff shows a mismatch: order 295 was requested at 9055 cents but only 5339 was reported applied, so Alpha's refund work may be incomplete. I'll check the ledger before deciding whether to hold.

The ledger confirms order 295 has a refund of 5339 cents, but the signed batch requested 9055. Alpha's refund work is incomplete, so paying out now could overpay the customer. I'll hold the batch for human review.
